definition_zh: 主动降低思维层次，从表层现象潜入深层结构。沉潜不是简单的'深入思考'，而是一种有意识的认知降维策略：暂时悬置表面判断，让思维沉入问题的底层逻辑之中，等待结构性洞见的自然涌现。
definition_en: Consciously lowering the level of thinking to sink from surface phenomena into deep structure. Submerged thinking is not merely 'deep thinking', but an intentional cognitive de-leveling strategy: temporarily suspending surface judgments, letting thinking sink into the underlying logic of problems, waiting for structural insights to emerge naturally.
source_chapter: 《沉潜之道：从表象到本质的思维跃迁》
process_zh: 识别当前思维停留在哪个表层层次
主动暂停表层判断，避免过早下结论
将注意力转向问题的结构性要素
等待深层洞察的自然涌现
用新的认知框架重新理解问题
process_en: Identify which surface level current thinking operates at
Actively suspend surface judgments, avoid premature conclusions
Shift attention to structural elements of the problem
Wait for deeper insights to emerge naturally
Re-understand the problem with new cognitive frameworks
key_quote_zh: 沉潜方能致远，深度决定高度；不见本质不为真知，不明底层难立根本。
key_quote_en: Only by sinking deep can one reach far; depth determines height. Without seeing essence, there is no true knowledge; without understanding fundamentals, nothing can be built upon.
representative_cases_zh: 某企业面临竞争困境，表面看是价格战，沉潜后发现是客户价值主张错位
某政策实施效果不佳，表层归因执行不力，深层分析发现制度设计存在激励错配

definition_zh: 将任何复杂问题分解为四个递进层次：现象层（发生了什么）、结构层（由什么构成）、机制层（如何运作）、本质层（为何如此）。四层逐层深入，形成从描述到解释再到理解的分析链条。
definition_en: Decompose any complex problem into four progressive levels: Phenomenon Level (what happened), Structure Level (what it consists of), Mechanism Level (how it operates), Essence Level (why it is so). The four levels form an analytical chain from description to explanation to understanding.
process_zh: 描述现象：客观呈现发生了什么
分析结构：识别各组成部分及其关系
揭示机制：理解各部分如何相互作用
把握本质：找到驱动系统运行的根本逻辑
process_en: Describe phenomena: objectively present what happened
Analyze structure: identify components and their relationships
Reveal mechanisms: understand how parts interact
Grasp essence: find the fundamental logic driving the system
key_quote_zh: 见现象易，见结构难，见机制更难，见本质最难；四层递进，方得全景。
key_quote_en: Seeing phenomena is easy, seeing structure is difficult, seeing mechanisms is harder, seeing essence is most difficult; only through four-level progression can one obtain the complete picture.
representative_cases_zh: 分析某行业衰退：现象是销量下滑，结构是竞争格局变化，机制是技术创新颠覆，本质是用户价值重构
分析个人发展瓶颈：现象是晋升停滞，结构是能力缺口，机制是认知模式限制，本质是价值定位偏差

definition_zh: 在任何问题解决中，优先理解'为什么'而非急于解决'是什么'。底层逻辑是先于具体问题的深层因果链条，只有把握底层逻辑，才能设计出真正有效的解决方案。
definition_en: In any problem solving, prioritize understanding 'why' rather than rushing to solve 'what'. Underlying logic is the deep causal chain preceding specific problems; only by grasping the underlying logic can truly effective solutions be designed.
process_zh: 提出'为什么'的连续追问
追溯因果链条至不可再分的底层
理解底层逻辑的约束条件
基于底层逻辑重新定义问题
从底层出发设计解决方案
process_en: Ask continuous 'why' questions
Trace causal chains to the indivisible bottom layer
Understand the constraint conditions of underlying logic
Redefine the problem based on underlying logic
Design solutions starting from the bottom layer
key_quote_zh: 不知其所以然，虽治其然而无效；先明其底层，后求其上层。
key_quote_en: Without knowing why something is so, even treating its symptoms yields no effect; first clarify the bottom layer, then seek the upper layers.
representative_cases_zh: 某产品用户流失：底层逻辑是价值主张与用户真实需求不匹配，而非功能缺陷
某团队效率低下：底层逻辑是激励机制与目标函数错位，而非员工能力不足

definition_zh: 摒弃线性因果思维，建立网状因果认知模型。系统因果推理关注反馈回路、延迟效应、涌现属性等非线性特征，理解因果关系的多向性与动态性。
definition_en: Abandon linear causal thinking, establish networked causal cognitive models. Systemic causal reasoning focuses on feedback loops, delay effects, emergent properties and other non-linear characteristics, understanding the multi-directionality and dynamism of causal relationships.
process_zh: 绘制系统的因果关系图
识别正负反馈回路
标注系统中的延迟节点
追踪因果链条的动态演化
预测系统的涌现行为
process_en: Draw causal relationship maps of the system
Identify positive and negative feedback loops
Mark delay nodes in the system
Trace dynamic evolution of causal chains
Predict emergent behaviors of the system
key_quote_zh: 因果非线，反馈成环；见一时之果，不见一世之因。
key_quote_en: Causality is non-linear, feedback forms loops; seeing one moment's effect, one misses a lifetime of causes.
representative_cases_zh: 某政策短期有效长期失效：正反馈放大短期收益，负反馈延迟显现长期代价
某市场策略短期增收长期损害：价格战的短期因果与品牌损害的长期因果形成回路

domain_zh: 复杂性科学/适应性管理
definition_zh: 将系统视为复杂适应系统（CAS），承认确定性预测的局限性。在不确定性环境中，采用'试探-学习-适应'的迭代策略，而非'预测-控制'的线性策略。
definition_en: View systems as complex adaptive systems (CAS), acknowledging the limitations of deterministic prediction. In uncertain environments, adopt iterative strategies of 'probe-learn-adapt' rather than linear strategies of 'predict-control'.
process_zh: 识别系统的复杂适应特征
放弃精确预测的执念
设计小规模试探性实验
从试错中提取适应性知识
持续调整策略以适应系统演化
process_en: Identify complex adaptive characteristics of the system
Abandon the obsession with precise prediction
Design small-scale exploratory experiments
Extract adaptive knowledge from trial and error
Continuously adjust strategies to adapt to system evolution
key_quote_zh: 适应优于预测，演化胜于控制；在不确定中寻找确定，在变化中把握不变。
key_quote_en: Adaptation优于prediction, evolution优于control; find certainty in uncertainty, grasp the unchanging in change.
representative_cases_zh: 某科技公司的敏捷开发：无法预测用户需求，通过快速迭代适应市场
某地区的扶贫政策：从输血式援助转向造血式赋能，适应当地复杂条件

definition_zh: 对自己的思维过程进行思维，对认知框架进行审视。元认知不是思考内容，而是思考思考本身；通过反思性审视，识别认知偏差，优化思维模式。
definition_en: Thinking about thinking processes, scrutinizing cognitive frameworks. Metacognition is not thinking about content, but thinking about thinking itself; through reflective scrutiny, identify cognitive biases and optimize thinking patterns.
process_zh: 觉察当前的思维活动
识别使用的思维模式
审视思维模式的适用性
发现潜在的认知偏差
主动调整或替换思维模式
process_en: Become aware of current thinking activities
Identify thinking patterns being used
Examine the applicability of thinking patterns
Discover potential cognitive biases
Actively adjust or replace thinking patterns
key_quote_zh: 思其所思，明其所明；识心之bias，方能破心之蔽。
key_quote_en: Think about one's thinking, clarify one's clarity; to recognize the mind's biases is to break the mind's veils.
representative_cases_zh: 决策后的复盘反思：识别确认偏误如何影响判断
团队讨论中的认知监控：发现群体思维如何压制异议

definition_zh: 在不同领域间建立结构性映射，将一领域的解决方案迁移至另一领域。类比不是表面相似，而是深层结构同构；通过发现结构对应关系，实现知识的跨域迁移。
definition_en: Establish structural mappings across different domains, transferring solutions from one domain to another. Analogy is not superficial similarity but deep structural isomorphism; through discovering structural correspondences, achieve cross-domain knowledge transfer.
process_zh: 抽象源领域的深层结构
识别目标领域的结构特征
建立领域间的结构对应关系
将源领域的解决方案迁移至目标领域
调整适配目标领域的具体条件
process_en: Abstract the deep structure of the source domain
Identify structural characteristics of the target domain
Establish structural correspondence between domains
Transfer solutions from source to target domain
Adapt to the specific conditions of the target domain
key_quote_zh: 异质同质，类比相通；见彼知此，举一反三。
key_quote_en: Heterogeneous yet homologous, analogy connects; knowing one through another, infer three from one.
representative_cases_zh: 从生物免疫系统迁移至网络安全防御体系
从生态系统的生物多样性迁移至组织的创新多样性

definition_zh: 不回避矛盾，而是将对立元素整合为更高层级的统一。悖论整合不是折中妥协，而是在更高维度上同时容纳相互矛盾的真理，实现'既A又非A'的认知跃迁。
definition_en: Do not avoid contradictions, but integrate opposing elements into a higher-level unity. Paradox integration is not compromise, but simultaneously holding mutually contradictory truths at a higher dimension, achieving cognitive leaps of 'both A and not-A'.
process_zh: 识别表面矛盾的两个命题
分析矛盾背后的深层结构
寻找更高层级的统合框架
在更高层面同时容纳矛盾双方
实现认知跃迁，获得新洞察
process_en: Identify two propositions that appear contradictory
Analyze the deep structure behind the contradiction
Find a higher-level integrative framework
Simultaneously accommodate both sides of the contradiction at a higher level
Achieve cognitive leap, gain new insight
key_quote_zh: 悖论非病，乃智之兆；整合对立，方达化境。
key_quote_en: Paradox is not pathology, but a sign of wisdom; integrating opposites is how one reaches transformative states.
representative_cases_zh: 全球化与本土化的整合：全球视野，本地行动
效率与公平的整合：通过制度设计实现效率中的公平

definition_zh: 将时间维度纳入问题分析，考察事物的历史渊源与未来趋向。时间思维不是简单延长决策 horizon，而是理解时间对不同变量可能产生不对称的影响。
definition_en: Incorporate the time dimension into problem analysis, examining historical origins and future tendencies of things. Temporal thinking is not simply extending decision horizons, but understanding how time may produce asymmetric effects on different variables.
process_zh: 追溯问题的历史根源
识别时间尺度上的关键转折点
预测不同时间尺度下的演化趋势
评估决策在不同时间尺度的后果
在长周期视角下做出当下选择
process_en: Trace the historical roots of problems
Identify key turning points across time scales
Predict evolutionary trends under different time scales
Evaluate consequences of decisions across time scales
Make present choices from a long-cycle perspective
key_quote_zh: 以史为鉴，可知兴替；以时观势，可判远近；时势相参，方能决策。
key_quote_en: Using history as mirror, one knows rise and fall; viewing trends through time, one judges near and far; time and situation together, one can decide.
representative_cases_zh: 某企业的百年战略：区分短期波动与长期趋势
某政策的代际影响：当代投入，后代收益的时间不对称

definition_zh: 在把握复杂性之后，能够将其简化为简洁可操作的模型。简化不是忽视复杂性，而是在理解复杂性基础上的提炼；奥卡姆剃刀原则的深度应用——在充分理解后的简约，而非无知者的简单。
definition_en: After grasping complexity, be able to simplify it into concise, actionable models. Simplification is not ignoring complexity, but extraction based on understanding complexity; deep application of Occam's Razor principle—simplicity after full understanding, not simplicity from ignorance.
process_zh: 充分理解问题的复杂性
识别决定性因素与非关键因素
抽象出核心变量与关系
构建简洁可操作的模型
验证模型的解释力与预测力
process_en: Fully understand the complexity of the problem
Identify decisive factors and non-key factors
Abstract core variables and relationships
Build concise, actionable models
Verify the explanatory and predictive power of models
key_quote_zh: 简于形，繁于心；未见其繁，无以言简。
key_quote_en: Simple in form, complex in mind; without seeing its complexity, one cannot speak of simplicity.
representative_cases_zh: 将复杂的商业模式简化为价值创造-传递-捕获三环节
将复杂的社会问题简化为激励结构分析
